name: Nagumo Kasumi
source:
Kasumi is a runaway girl who suddenly arrived at the doorsteps of [url=/c14771]Naoki[/url]'s place and is forcibly living with him at the moment. She is calm and cool, high computing, but ignorant to love.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off:_Yubikiri_no_Kioku]Wikipedia[/url].]
